_comment: Accepted transcript-seam census findings. Keys are arm:file::qualname (no line numbers); count = accepted constructions at that site. Add an entry ONLY with a note explaining why the site is accepted; prefer routing construction through core.llm.transcript.build_llm_client / core.llm.factory.get_client, or fencing the surface with fence_unadopted_dispatch. check_transcript_seam.py fails CI on any site not listed here, fails when a listed site's count grows, and warns on stale entries.
